requirements.requirement: Processor versus organism
requirements.source_passages: S02 Introduction; S03 §§0–3; S32 complete neuron
requirements.historical_instruction: Early ArcLoom is a structural-perception processor with couplers, UF, lattice, folded memory and governance; later files call an entire software agent the substrate.
requirements.canonical_disposition: Preserve hardware architecture and its own conformance classes. Guala is its bounded neuromorphic simulation proving ground; a processor witness is not whole-organism cognition. Neither software implementation language nor processor name establishes conformance.
requirements.code_relationship: HDL/UFCP and Python/Rust organism lineages require separate build and mounting evidence. Task1598 functional authority is a distinct implementation.
requirements.remediation_acceptance: Bind every claim to processor, kernel, neuron, organ or organism scope, exact source and executable witness.

requirements.requirement: Exact MathLoom arithmetic
requirements.historical_instruction: Balanced trits use Val(A)=sum(a_i*3^i), local digit constraints, carry and verified settlement; later designs conflate ternary positions with energy or neuron counts.
requirements.canonical_disposition: Retain exact positional arithmetic, typed numerator/denominator and full digits. Carry out is part of the value. 3^p is significance, not a physical gain or anatomical population rule. Refusal is not a valid numerical zero.
requirements.code_relationship: The October corrected contract retains the exact codec while rejecting its flattened consumer; codec success alone does not qualify the neuron.
requirements.remediation_acceptance: Prove value/carry identities, negative and fractional representation, type and position preservation, overflow refusal, and complete cold continuation.

requirements.code_relationship: Task1598 Python sources retain per-stream records. A complete source-to-loaded-native proof of the current joint path is still required; eight transported numbers are insufficient.

requirements.historical_instruction: Neuron→cluster→mosaic→tapestry→hemisphere is fixed; 8×50 seeds and 8,000–30,000 targets; contact inhibition uses an underived square.
requirements.canonical_disposition: Preserve differentiated connected populations and bounded development. Reject imposed semantic tiers and count-defined capability. Current 64-column scope is the work boundary, not a proof of 64 brains or a mandate to recreate the earlier population.

requirements.requirement: Story and whole experience
requirements.source_passages: S11 E6/P6/P7; S13 §2; S31 complete definition
requirements.historical_instruction: Experience-First restores place, ambient state, participants and sequence; later storage designs turn shared windows/tags into memory.
requirements.canonical_disposition: Retain the story requirement and no-state-loss priority. Replace tags/window identity as proof with actual internal/external participants, timing, cause and consequence. Zero sensory quotas; a silent event can be an experience.
requirements.code_relationship: Current sound-gated moments conflict with this requirement even if they carry a small context tuple.
requirements.remediation_acceptance: Change one real context or bodily condition with sensory custody; preserve the resulting distinction and test later selective reassembly without injecting its label.

requirements.requirement: Window retrieval is not distributed recall
requirements.historical_instruction: Recall reads ranked window siblings; recognition is nearest-neighbor shape search; the WAL is called memory; whole windows replay and promote.
requirements.canonical_disposition: Keep atomic custody, actual context and durable history. Reject lookup, ranking, promotion tiers and original-episode replay as cognition. The index resolves evidence; the living distributed circuit must reassemble.
requirements.code_relationship: August paging and later cognitive-chain authority explicitly separate addresses from recall. Archived old windows may be historical evidence only.
requirements.remediation_acceptance: A later partial cue must cause retained pathways to change current settlement and action; returning archived bytes is insufficient.

requirements.requirement: One organism versus component owner architecture
requirements.historical_instruction: July6 proposes independent Atlas/Coordinator/Dream owners over an event stream; July16 restores one v5 brain with separate bookkeeping organs.
requirements.canonical_disposition: Retain bounded ingress, observability and one explicit runtime closure. Do not revive independently deciding owners, mirrored minds or a bus as cognition. Parallel physical work is allowed only with one coherent predecessor/successor.
requirements.code_relationship: A module graph or named organ inventory cannot establish whole-brain participation. The present product requires a single authoritative native causal owner.
requirements.remediation_acceptance: Prove ordered simultaneous-input handling, atomic complete-state continuation and no second decision path under ordinary startup.

requirements.requirement: Sleep and social drives
requirements.historical_instruction: Sleep gains a hard override; drives use book-repeat penalties, LRU, accuracy growth, inverted-U, pair-bond gates and calibrated deprivation thresholds.
requirements.canonical_disposition: Keep actual fatigue/recovery, social experience, play and curiosity responsibilities. Reject reward/scoring controllers, forced sleep and calibrated behavior timers. A proposal citing biology is not a derived local material law.
requirements.code_relationship: The July18 packet itself says approval pending and describes earlier failed designs. Its 3/3 review does not override current architecture.
requirements.remediation_acceptance: Measure depletion/recovery and state-dependent internal activity; interventions must alter the physical cause, not set an activity flag or a desired outcome.

requirements.remediation_acceptance: Match complete retained state and its next successor across an approved mapping; record any nonconvertible learned content and obtain exact authority before cutover.

requirements.remediation_acceptance: Show internally recombined retained relations, truthful prospective provenance, inhibited external enactment during thought and later causal consequence.

requirements.remediation_acceptance: Use operation-specific causal controls, genuine partial cues where claimed, context reinstatement for episodic claims, and embodied consequence for procedural claims.

requirements.requirement: Optical quanta and remainder conservation
requirements.historical_instruction: Optical energy accumulates into whole lattice quanta, but proof1 equates delivered quanta alone to the exact integral over any interval sequence.
requirements.canonical_disposition: Preserve the remainder. The accounting identity is delivered_energy + final_remainder - initial_remainder = integrated_input. Whole delivered quanta alone equal the input only when the remainder difference is zero. This is an algebraic correction of the stated proof, not new calibration.
requirements.code_relationship: The historical law declares 1/16 zJ and 2*L*T; this review does not transfer those particular constants into current anatomy.
requirements.remediation_acceptance: Test subquantum, exact-quantum and mixed-duration sequences including nonzero initial/final remainder; no rounding loss or forced gate opening.

requirements.canonical_disposition: Preserve charge conservation and the passive energy boundary. Do not infer that energy descent alone proves an accurate coupled dynamical solver or that every active/pumped transition must decrease stored energy.
requirements.code_relationship: Historical dissipation and contact constants are separately bound to their anatomy; no universal damping or modern steering remedy follows.
requirements.remediation_acceptance: Test odd/even charge differences, heat/work balance, active sources, recovery and exact restored continuation across the admitted regimes.

requirements.requirement: Stimulus-end rest versus post-quiescence fractal

requirements.historical_instruction: August5 proposes finalizing on the first dark settlement and explicitly re-grounds the reference as rest-not-quiescent; definitive/current guidance defines pre/post-quiescence deltas.

Recover the delegation/review and subsequent implementation before deciding any historical retained body meets that definition.

requirements.requirement: A-011.6 synthetic junction constitution
requirements.historical_instruction: 6400 available/50 conducting channels, 10 pS each and a specific rational transition-work quantum are explicitly authored synthetic constitution, not values forced by literature.

requirements.requirement: Resource bounds preserve causative state

requirements.historical_instruction: Old whole-organism owners sum fixed record/byte ceilings; runaway storage duplicated unchanged payloads; later tests raise numerical-work ceilings to billions.
requirements.canonical_disposition: Preserve bounded reached work and exact content reuse. Reject record eviction as a memory remedy, full-copy publication, or increased allowance as proof of efficiency. Counted terms, bytes, forces and joules are different quantities.

requirements.requirement: Depletion and eating are one causal body/world boundary
requirements.source_passages: S34 §§1–3 and doorway decision; S45 oral contact
requirements.historical_instruction: R1 requires actual loss/replenishment and oral mass transfer; later nourishment prose introduces a 2000-ug food viability threshold and named candidate affordances.
requirements.canonical_disposition: Retain real contact, finite transferable material, absorption/waste/heat and deficit sensed internally. requirements.requirement: External provision and consumed remnants

requirements.code_relationship: World upkeep and caregiver actions remain potential sensory influences; test them separately from the organism policy.
requirements.remediation_acceptance: Verify idempotence, no interference with held/busy objects, geometry-valid relocated provision, material custody, and fresh sensory learning without memory reset or semantic un-veto.

requirements.code_relationship: Exact Task1598 source retains learned worth and cosine threshold mechanisms; package and runtime claims remain separately scoped.
requirements.remediation_acceptance: Trace all action/speech callers and persisted decision state; replacement must produce internally prepared efference from retained physical state without the table, list order or canned phoneme answer.

requirements.historical_instruction: Region-growing thresholds become three quantized radial rings; the current action target supplies figure location/extent; earlier stability bars are softened to dominant/top-two keys.

requirements.requirement: World optics versus cognition
requirements.historical_instruction: Windows, rays, lamps, material looks, boxes and parts improve a previously flat/spherical world; a simplified real-clock solar curve and several approximations are called geometry only.
requirements.canonical_disposition: Keep useful world geometry/occlusion/rendering responsibilities. Label authored scene content and numerical/rendering approximations honestly. They are not learned object recognition, exact solar physics or neuronal laws.
requirements.code_relationship: The spec itself records an initially unmounted lighting path and later latency from per-pixel rational conversion and whole-world receipt encoding.
requirements.remediation_acceptance: Verify the retina actually used by the ordinary loop, source-identical render evidence, consistent frames/occlusion and measured mature cost; no hidden metadata enters cognition.

requirements.requirement: Six cognitive assets do not replace whole-brain scope
requirements.historical_instruction: Six assets prescribe salience sums, inverse graph planning, cosine>=0.65, world-coordinate permanence, demand chains and semantic text-to-sense conversion.
requirements.canonical_disposition: Retain six intended functions within the broader catalog. Reject those proposed algorithms under current constraints. Correct Production Complete labels where they certify a forbidden mechanism rather than the requested function.
requirements.code_relationship: Task1598 spectral_cosine_similarity and learned speech logic make the distinction operational, not just historical prose.
